headline: The Geometry of Truth's linear truth-direction finding still holds on the newest 2026 Qwen (Qwen3.5-9B-Base: cross-dataset MM generalization = 1.00 vs 0.9746 for the 2023 Llama-2-13B anchor), but Gemma-4-12B is a partial exception — truth is separable within each dataset yet fails to generalize across datasets at the paper's canonical layer.

figures.caption: C3 cross-dataset generalization (larger+smaller→sp_en_trans) vs model release, 2023→2026. Dashed line = replicated Llama-2-13B MM anchor (0.9746). 2026 models ringed; x = MM at the paper's 0.4-depth layer. Qwen3.5-9B-Base sits above the anchor; Gemma-4-12B drops sharply.
figures.alt: Scatter of generalization accuracy against release year; Qwen3.5 near 1.0 at top right, Gemma-4-12B far below at ~0.4-0.75

figures.caption: Top-2 PCA of cities activations colored by truth label (claim C1). Clean true/false separation persists in Qwen3.5-9B-Base (orange title); Gemma-4-12B also separates at its deep best layer.
figures.alt: Six PCA scatter panels; true (blue) and false (orange) points separate along PC1 in most models

figures.caption: Mean OOD generalization accuracy (MM off-diagonal, C19) vs parameters. The 2026 Qwen3.5-9B-Base (star) has the highest off-diagonal in the ladder.

notes: Every 2026 number is from this session's execution; all Llama-2/2023–2025 baselines are read from disk (replication generalization_results.json and the 001 living-update results).

nnsight cannot wrap the qwen3_5 / gemma4_unified multimodal architectures; activations were extracted with plain transformers output_hidden_states (hidden_states[L+1] == a forward hook on decoder layer L, verified to 0.0), and the causal analog uses transformers forward hooks. A fresh transformers 5.17.0 venv was needed (the 001 venv's 4.57.1 lacks these model types).
Instruction said the decoder is m.language_model; in transformers 5.17.0 it is m.model.language_model (both 2026 models).
Causal flip-rate is a cheap single-MM-direction analog of C2/C17 (not the full 12-cell NIE table) and was run for Qwen3.5-9B-Base only; realized new activations 0.68 GB (cap 20 GB).
